query:
SELECT * FROM (SELECT
                          bp.id,
                          bp.account_id,
                          bp.board_id,
                          bp.icon,
                          -- Use get_i18n_string for title, content, and location translations with fallback
                          get_i18n_string(bp.title, $1) AS title,
                          get_i18n_string(bp.content, $1) AS content,
                          get_i18n_string(bp.location, $1) AS location,
                          bp.event_from,
                          bp.event_to,
                          bp.created_at,
                          NULL AS "pinned_on: Vec<i32>"
                            FROM board_posts bp
                            LEFT JOIN board_group_perms bgp ON bp.board_id = bgp.board_id
                            LEFT JOIN account_group_memberships agm ON bgp.group_id = agm.group_id WHERE CASE WHEN bp.event_to IS NOT NULL THEN bp.event_to >= NOW() - interval '3 hours' ELSE bp.created_at > NOW() - interval '1 day' END
                          AND (bp.visibility IN ('public', 'logged_in') OR (bgp.perm >= 'view' AND agm.account_id = $2) OR account_role_exists($2, 'board_manager'::app_role))
                          AND bp.board_id = ANY($3)
                          GROUP BY bp.id
                         )  WHERE (title ILIKE '%' || $4 || '%' OR location ILIKE '%' || $4 || '%')
                          ORDER BY (event_from <= now() AND event_to >= now()), created_at DESC LIMIT $5 OFFSET $6
